title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT "PORTA E RE" RESIDENCE IN OLD SAUK
description_en: In one of the elite areas of Tirana, very close to the Palace of Brigades in a premium residential complex, a super modern 1+1 typology apartment is for sale. The apartment has a total area of ​​91.14m2. Porta Tirana e Re is an exclusive residential residence with only 39 families on 8,190m² of land. Greenery, gardens and public spaces occupy 80% of the land surface, while construction only 20% of it. Construction is expected to finish in June 2026. For more information, contact us!
